MoveIt.SECTION_TITLE[UseMKey]: Move It - "M"キーを使用しますか？
MoveIt.TOOLTIP_DESCRIPTION[YesUseMKey]: Move It で"M"キーを使用します
MoveIt.TOOLTIP_DESCRIPTION[NoUseMKey]: Move Itでは"Shif+M"キーを使用します
MoveIt.TOOLTIP_DESCRIPTION[Undo]: 最後の動作を元に戻します。
MoveIt.TOOLTIP_DESCRIPTION[Single]: 選択された物を一つずつ移動します。
MoveIt.TOOLTIP_DESCRIPTION[Marquee]: Select Moveables by drawing a box.
MoveIt.TOOLTIP_DESCRIPTION[Manipulation]: Select a network to manipulate its control points to change it's shape.
MoveIt.TOOLTIP_DESCRIPTION[Redo]: Redoes a Move It Action that was undone.
MoveIt.TOOLTIP_DESCRIPTION[Filters]: When opened, allows filtering based on different categories. Filtering doesn't apply when Filters Foldout is closed. Right click a category to enable it and disable the others.
MoveIt.TOOLTIP_DESCRIPTION[BuildingsFilt: Toggled on allows Building to be selected. Off to filter out Buildings.
MoveIt.TOOLTIP_DESCRIPTION[PlantsFilter]: Toggled on allows Plants to be selected. Off to filter out Plants.
MoveIt.TOOLTIP_DESCRIPTION[DecalsFilter]: Toggled on allows Decals to be selected. Off to filter out Decals.
MoveIt.TOOLTIP_DESCRIPTION[PropsFilter]: Toggled on allows Props to be selected. Off to filter out Props.
MoveIt.TOOLTIP_DESCRIPTION[SurfacesFilte: Toggled on allows Surfaces to be selected. Off to filter out Surfaces.
MoveIt.TOOLTIP_DESCRIPTION[NodesFilter]: Toggled on allows Nodes to be selected. Off to filter out Nodes.
MoveIt.TOOLTIP_DESCRIPTION[SegmentsFilte: Toggled on allows Segments to be selected. Off to filter out Segments.
MoveIt.TOOLTIP_DESCRIPTION[NetLanesFilte: Toggled on allows NetLanes to be selected. Off to filter out NetLanes.
MoveIt.TOOLTIP_DESCRIPTION[Toolbox]: Additional tools to control the behavior of Move It Tool on the selected elements.
MoveIt.TOOLTIP_DESCRIPTION[TerrainHeight: Moves selected objects to the terrain height. Does not work with buildings or on-ground networks.
MoveIt.TOOLTIP_DESCRIPTION[ObjectHeight]: Click on an object to move selected objects to that object's height
MoveIt.TOOLTIP_DESCRIPTION[RotateAtCente: Click on an object to rotate selected objects about their centroid to face the same angle as that object.
MoveIt.TOOLTIP_DESCRIPTION[RotateInPlace: Click on an object to rotate selected objects in place to face the same angle as that object.

**Warning: Gooee Detected**

Gooee is an abandoned mod dependency that **will** cause problems with Move It and other mods, and should be removed. However after removal parts of it may remain in your local ModsData folder which must be cleaned up.

1. Close the game.
 2. Remove Gooee if it exists.
 3. Delete the Gooee folder in your local ModsData folder.
